name: meta
description: Meta's AI fetchers: meta-externalagent (model training and indexing for Meta products) and meta-externalfetcher (fetches a link a user asked about). Both classify as agent/meta from the User-Agent alone, at medium confidence. User-Agent strings are transcribed verbatim from Meta's published crawler documentation (https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/sharing/webmasters/web-crawlers, fetched 2026-09-28), including the relative documentation path Meta prints; they are not captured from our own traffic, and the other headers are illustrative. Replace a sample with a real capture the first time one is observed.
